title: voice-settings-redesign: the per-track gear + point-mode buttons move from the graph overlay into the track's header bar; the «Настройки дорожки» dialog becomes a two-pane form (variant B); solo-spectrum and solo-wave sublane gears get their OWN dialogs (per-lane spectrum settings with «Сброс»-to-inherit; wave colour+opacity), and those sections leave the track dialog

decisions.text: RESOLVED at the VS0.1 PAUSE (owner). The owner's «тулбар голоса» = the per-track header bar GT11.5 (tracks-panel__gtrack-header, TracksPanel.vue:149-186 — stripe, fold, hidden-graphs eye, title; no gear today). BOTH overlay buttons move there: the settings gear AND the point-mode toggle (edit_location_alt) — owner picked «Тоже перенести в шапку» over keeping point-mode on the canvas. The gtrack-view__actions overlay (GTrackView.vue:83-103) is removed entirely; no buttons remain drawn in the graph. Bonus: the header is visible even when the track is folded, so access improves (today a folded track has no gear at all).

RESOLVED at the VS0.1 PAUSE (owner): redesign = VARIANT B, two-pane, modelled on the overall-waveform dialog GT10.29 (TracksPanel.vue:722-810 — section list left, content right). Sections: «График» (display mode + beat band), «Соло-звук» (TWO independent toggles «Волна»/«Спектр» replacing the 4-way off/wave/spectrum/both toggle whose «Оба» was the comprehension killer, + placement toggle with self-explanatory labels «Отдельным графиком ниже»/«Фоном под кривыми», long hint → short caption), «Голоса» (checklist). NO style settings remain in the dialog — spectrum behind its graph's gear (VS-D3), wave colour/opacity behind its graph's gear (VS-D4). Delete-track stays in the footer; title simplified to «Настройки дорожки». Rejected: A (flat form, wave style inline — obsoleted by VS-D4 moving style out), C (accordion). UI-only change: soloMode off|wave|spectrum|both stays the persisted model, the two toggles map onto it (R5).

REVISED AGAIN 2026-07-17 — rev 3 (owner after VS2.4): «Окно настроек соло-спектра должно быть оформлено в виде стандартного докабл-детачбл окна, как у общего спектра». So not only the FORM is the standard one (rev 2), the WINDOW CHROME is too: a PanelWindow @panel exactly like the overall spectrum's «Параметры» (SpectrumSettingsDialog is the model). Built in VS2.7: stores/lane-spectrum-panel.ts (panelId 'lane-spectrum-settings', floating default, + a module-level target-lane ref — ONE panel instance retargeted per gear click, the SG-D7 pattern), LaneSpectrumSettingsDialog.vue (PanelWindow chrome hosting the mono SpectrogramOverridesView lazily; applies both local and bridged actions to the lane override), LaneSpectrumSettingsRemote.vue (detached child, mono twin of SpectrogramOverridesRemote, SS-D3: no child-side store) + module.ts panels entry; hosted in AudioPage's shared dock-wrap (Teleport-to-body when floating, joins dockWrapClass). The q-dialog host from rev 2 is deleted from TracksPanel — the gear just sets the target lane + opens the shared panel state. --- rev 2 (owner at the VS2.3 PAUSE, still true for the CONTENT): «в точности тот самый диалог… 100% переиспользование готового контрола», в режиме Моно — SpectrogramOverridesView gained the `mono` prop (hides the L/R nav); the channel-based OverridesSnapshot/ActionContext contract fits mono naturally (channel0=channel1=laneOverride; setChannel/setBoth→setLaneSpectrum, clear*→clearLaneSpectrum), preserving SG-D8 auto-individual + presets-apply + «Сброс»→inherit as the view's own chrome. GTrackSpectrumSettings is NOT the reused control — it dies with the track-dialog section in VS3.1. Still true from rev 1: the toggle+accordion leave the track dialog (owner req. 2); inline placement has no gear (VS0.1). SUPERSEDED: rev 2's q-dialog host (built VS2.4, replaced by the panel in VS2.7); rev 1's bespoke GTrackSpectrumSettings dialog (built VS2.1, rejected at VS2.3).

PHASE 4 DESIGN (owner requirement 2026-07-18, verbatim: «Рефактор формы отображения графиков в настройках дорожки. 1. Режим отображения нужно переименовать в Реживы отображения 2. Все режимы нужно сразу вывести на форму в виде отдельных блоков видимых сразу (уйти от текущих вкладок Ьазовая частота, Частота биений, Громкость, Баланс. 3. В каждом блоке должен появиться чекбокс Отображать на графике. Какие графики выбраны, такие и отображаем.») — the checkbox-per-mode form implies MULTIPLE simultaneous modes per lane, so the single lane.mode becomes modes: GTrackMode[] with a per-mode graph stack in the lane. OPEN at the VS4.0 PAUSE: (а) render = stacked per-mode GTrackViews inside the lane (own resize each; recommended — mirrors the solo sub-graph stack) vs overlaying curves in one canvas (axes clash); (б) zero checked = forbid unchecking the last one (recommended) vs a curve-less lane; (в) «Полоса бита» moves INSIDE the «Базовая частота» block; (г) how the track-list bulk actions (set-voice-mode, «Показать все режимы» = today one lane per voice×mode) re-express over modes[].

REVISED 2026-07-17 (owner at the VS2.3 PAUSE — the VS2.2 build was rejected): «Всё то же самое, что написано в п.2, относится и к диалогу настроек соло-волны. У нас уже есть нужный диалог в настройках общей волны (режим Моно)». So the lane wave gear opens the EXISTING overall-waveform two-pane dialog (WS1.1), which already has a mono mode (WS-D4: a single «Моно» tab), retargeted at the lane: waveformSettingsLaneId non-null routes the dialog's colour/scale/opacity controls to that lane's solo-wave fields (setLaneSoloWaveStyle/setLaneSoloWaveScale) instead of the overall channel groups; the link toggle is hidden, opacity always shown (it drives the inline underlay). To make the mono form IDENTICAL the lane gained soloWaveScale (lin/dB, persisted with the lane config, wired to both the sublane and inline WaveformView). SUPERSEDED rev 1: a small bespoke colour+opacity dialog (built in VS2.2, rejected).

evidence: The checkbox form is a MODEL change, not a dialog skin: lane.mode is singular (use-gtrack-lanes.ts:32) and is read by the renderer (GTrackView :mode — axis, beat band, point mapping), point dragging (dragPoint(..., lane.mode)), the lane label (gtrackLaneLabel), per-lane curveHeight (ONE curve graph per lane today), and the track-list bulk actions.

«Все режимы» already exists as a LAYOUT action (showAllModesPerVoice — one lane per voice×mode, use-gtrack-lanes.ts:967-976); phase 4 moves that capability INTO a single lane (modes[]), so the bulk actions need re-expression (VS-D5г).

The natural render shape is the existing stack pattern: the lane already stacks solo wave/spectrum sub-graphs under the curve with per-graph heights (GT11.7) — per-mode curve graphs slot into the same architecture.
